_about: Who does what, in failover order. The first machine in a list that is active and checked in is the one serving that role; the next one takes over when it is disconnected or goes quiet. Edit this file to change the order, then re-run install-fleet.ps1 (or copy it to C:\Jarvis\fleet\).

homebase.label: Junk laptop (backup: Home Assistant, wake relay)

hub.label: Phone app + approvals
hub.note: The hub moved to the 5060 on 10/02. The junk laptop's copy is disabled, so it only serves if someone turns it back on.

worker.label: Claude Worker (task cards)
worker.note: The junk laptop's Worker is off for good (running it next to the 5060's would double-claim cards). machine:any cards go to whichever Worker is active; cards pinned to one machine wait for it.

printer.label: 3D printer control
printer.note: The print service moved to the 5060 with the hub; no standby.
